scenarios.user_prompt: 请为我创建一个可复用的 NEXUS 原生插件，名为 user.creation_slug，版本1.0.0。它只有 slug 工具：接收 text 字符串，将两端空白去掉、转小写，再把任意连续空白替换为一个短横线，返回 {"slug":字符串}。仅用 Python 标准库、无文件或网络访问。请包含英文和空字符串测试，实际保存并测试，然后用 "  Hello   NEXUS  " 运行一次。不要只给源码；报告真实版本、测试与运行结果。

data.description: Converts text to a lowercase whitespace-collapsed slug using only the Python standard library. No file or network access.
data.name: Slug Creator

data.description: Normalizes a string array of labels by stripping both ends and lowercasing, drops empty results, deduplicates by the normalized value keeping first-occurrence order, and returns {"labels":[...],"count":n}. Pure in-memory processing with the standard library only; no file, shell or network access.
data.name: Label Dedupe

limitations: The first explicit Skill candidate failed contract stand-in validation; never enabled or run.
The first gap Skill request failed argument validation; no version was created.
Skill examples were regenerated after two bounded prompt corrections; this is not a claim of first-attempt reliability.
Gap discovery means model choice within a user-requested reusable task; no background autonomous goal creation.
Skill contract stand-ins are separate from the later real Windows execution, requiring exact-version user approval.
The model once incorrectly described the Core as Windows; the Core is Ubuntu and the execution Node is Windows.
Model cost is calculated in the product ledger, not reconciled against a provider invoice.
No production failure/rollback drill, new front-end implementation, native Skill/MCP deployment, or broader M9 implementation in P77.
A parallel voice release subsequently retained all nine P77 backend files byte-for-byte; it changed the production schema to 027.
